__guidelines.source: Reinforced selection and layout guidance merged from markdown_files/reinforced_visuals.md. Existing per-template constraints remain authoritative for field placement and numeric limits.
precedence: Follow each template's constraints for exact word counts, line limits, permitted fields, and content placement.
Use these reinforced guidelines to choose the template, understand its layout intent, and avoid unsuitable templates.
If reinforced guidance conflicts with a template constraint, the template constraint wins.
core_decision_rules: Prefer Face Only for narrative, anecdotal, conversational, transitional, or visually unstructured speech.
Do not force a graphic when it adds no direct educational value.
Match the template density to the amount and structure of source content; do not fill unused capacity with invented material.
Use only facts, labels, relationships, quantities, and images explicitly supported by the transcript.
Prefer the simplest template that can accurately hold the content.

formatting_rules.plate_heading: ALL CAPS, as short as possible, normally no more than 2 lines and 32 characters unless the selected template is stricter or forbids a heading.
formatting_rules.subheadings: Title Case. Every generated content block should have a subheading unless the selected template explicitly forbids subheadings or headings.
formatting_rules.description_text: Sentence case. Prefer 10-15 words or fewer per sentence and no more than 2 sentences per paragraph unless the selected template is stricter.
formatting_rules.icons: Use line icons only, never black-fill icons. Numbers or short forms may replace icons only where the selected template permits it.
formatting_rules.hard_limits: Never exceed a template's own word, line, item, point, or box limits. Split content into another plate when the template specifies overflow behavior.

image_policy.default: Do not assume, invent, or request image assets.
image_policy.conditional_replacement: Timeline Template 1 may replace milestone text with an explicitly supported image.
image_policy.requirement: When an image-capable template is selected, identify the specific supported asset, subject, logo, person, or case-study image in why_chosen/content; do not fabricate an asset.

variant_policy.default: Prefer Split Screen over the corresponding OG/full-screen variant.
use_og_only_when: The graphic is too dense to share space with the speaker.
The content is a standalone reference plate with no accompanying narration.
The script or producer explicitly requests full-screen or OG treatment.
variant_policy.justification: Whenever an OG variant is selected, why_chosen must state why the Split Screen variant was insufficient.

relationship_routing.comparison: Use Differentiation templates only for exactly two parallel, non-ordered sides.
relationship_routing.process: Use Process templates when order, progression, cause-and-effect, before/after, or one action leading to another is present.
relationship_routing.timeline: Use Timeline templates only for explicit chronological milestones or progression over time.
relationship_routing.hierarchy: Use Hierarchy Template 1 only for parent-child, taxonomy, organizational, or architectural relationships.
relationship_routing.graphs: Use Graph templates only when explicit numeric data supports the selected line, bar, or pie relationship.

downweighted_policy.rule: Actively penalize these high-capacity templates. Use them only when dense source text cannot be simplified into standard Type, Process, Differentiation, or Timeline templates.
downweighted_policy.justification: why_chosen must name the simpler alternative considered and explain why it could not hold the supported content.

timestamp_rules: Assign content.heading_timestamp independently from the point timestamps, using the exact word-level moment when the heading should appear.
Assign every generated item/detail the word-level start timestamp where that idea begins.
The earliest item/detail must begin after content.heading_timestamp; the delay is selected from the spoken content and is not a fixed duration.
Keep every timestamp inside the current session's start/end range.
Do not reuse one timestamp for unrelated items merely because they share a plate.
Do not invent timestamps for content not grounded in the transcript.

output_mapping.content.title: The plate heading or primary on-screen title; leave empty when the selected template forbids a heading.
output_mapping.content.heading_timestamp: The exact word-level time when the plate heading appears, independently editable from the first point.
output_mapping.content.items: Flat labels, steps, milestones, pointers, categories, or short statements. Each entry uses value and timestamp.
output_mapping.content.details: Structured label/value pairs such as a category plus description, question plus answer, comparison side plus explanation, statistic plus context, or graph label plus value.
output_mapping.subheadings: Curriculum highlights separate from the visual-template payload; keep them concise and do not duplicate visual content unnecessarily.
output_mapping.why_chosen: Explain the transcript signal, density fit, layout fit, and any OG, image, or downweighted-template justification.

common_mistakes: Choosing a graphic template for narrative or transitional speech instead of Face Only.
Choosing an OG variant without explaining why Split Screen cannot work.
Using Differentiation for sequential, causal, or before/after content.
Using a graph without explicit source numbers or omitting the graph source.
Inventing images, icons, statistics, labels, subpoints, or relationships not present in the transcript.
Using a downweighted heavy-text plate for ordinary lecture points.
Exceeding a template's capacity instead of splitting the material across plates.
Adding headings, descriptions, subheadings, or pointers to a template that explicitly forbids them.

Face Only.layout_intent: Speaker-only default with no graphic overlay.
Face Only.avoid_when: A clear supported list, comparison, process, timeline, hierarchy, definition, statistic, or other visual structure is present.

Template 1.layout_intent: Low-density categorization with short labels and compact differentiators.
Template 1.avoid_when: Each type requires a paragraph or several detailed supporting points.

Template 2.layout_intent: Denser categorization where every type needs meaningful supporting explanation.
Template 2.avoid_when: The source provides only labels or one short differentiator per type.

Template No 16 Split Screen.layout_intent: Speaker-left sequential concept or step treatment with compact descriptions.
Template No 16 Split Screen.avoid_when: The points require deep explanations or supporting images.

Template No 16 OG.layout_intent: Full-screen version of the compact sequential-step treatment.
Template No 16 OG.avoid_when: The Split Screen version has enough room.

Template No 17 Split Screen.layout_intent: Numbered deep-dive points with room for expanded explanation or a supported image.
Template No 17 Split Screen.avoid_when: All points are short enough for Template No 16 or a standard Type template.

Template No 17 OG.layout_intent: Full-screen deep-dive point treatment when the visual/explanation cannot share space with the speaker.
Template No 17 OG.avoid_when: The Split Screen version has enough room.

Template No 18 Split Screen.layout_intent: Speaker-visible question-and-answer plate showing both question and answer together.
Template No 18 Split Screen.avoid_when: The transcript contains prompts without answers or ordinary explanatory points.

Template No 18 OG.avoid_when: The Split Screen Q&A version has enough room.

Template No 20 Split Screen.layout_intent: Exactly two parallel concepts with short descriptions or compact pointers.
Template No 20 Split Screen.avoid_when: The relationship is causal, sequential, before/after, or a true comparison requiring differentiation framing.

Template No 20 OG.layout_intent: Full-screen two-concept plate when the two supported content blocks are too dense for Split Screen.
Template No 20 OG.avoid_when: The Split Screen version has enough room.

Template No 21 Split Screen.layout_intent: Exactly three highly visual concepts using labels and icons with almost no supporting text.
Template No 21 Split Screen.avoid_when: Any concept requires substantial callouts or sub-pointers.

Template No 21 OG.layout_intent: Three visual concepts with brief supported callouts or branches.
Template No 21 OG.avoid_when: The concepts need only labels/icons or the Split Screen version can hold them.

Template No 22 Split Screen.layout_intent: Compact multi-category overview with short titles, descriptions, and mandatory icons/numbers.

Template No 22 OG.layout_intent: Full-screen multi-category overview with slightly more description space.
Template No 22 OG.avoid_when: The Split Screen version can hold the supported text.

Template No 23 Split Screen.layout_intent: Minimal split-screen process/flow using short step text only.

Template No 23 OG.layout_intent: Full-screen minimal process/flow with slightly longer step text.
Template No 23 OG.avoid_when: The Split Screen version can hold the flow.

Template No 24 Glass BOX.layout_intent: Single low-density percentage/statistic glassbox without a plate heading.
Template No 24 Glass BOX.avoid_when: Multiple values need comparison or a graph.

Template No 24 Split Screen.layout_intent: Speaker-visible statistic glassbox with optional compact heading/context.
Template No 24 Split Screen.avoid_when: Multiple values need comparison or a graph.

Template No 25 Glass Box.layout_intent: Logo/image recall plate with no explanatory text.
Template No 25 Glass Box.avoid_when: No specific supported asset is identified or explanation text is necessary.

Template No 26 Question Box.avoid_when: An answer, explanation, heading, or multiple questions must also appear.

Template No 26 OG.layout_intent: Full-screen single reflection/discussion question with the larger permitted question limit.
Template No 26 OG.avoid_when: The shorter Question Box is sufficient.

Template No 27.layout_intent: Definition plate pairing a concise supported definition with a specific illustration/vector area.
Template No 27.avoid_when: The content explains a process rather than defining a term.

Template No 28.layout_intent: Memorable quote/principle plate with stylized quotation treatment.
Template No 28.avoid_when: The statement is an ordinary lecture sentence rather than a deliberate quotation or maxim.

Type Template No 29.layout_intent: Headerless takeaway/conclusion plate emphasizing one brief supported sentence.
Type Template No 29.avoid_when: Multiple points or a detailed definition must appear.

Type Template No 30.layout_intent: Horizontal high-capacity framework boxes for dense supported detail.
Type Template No 30.avoid_when: A simpler Type 1, Type 2, No 20, No 21, or No 22 layout can hold the content.

Template No 31.layout_intent: Vertically stacked high-capacity boxes when each category needs substantial explanation.
Template No 31.avoid_when: A simpler category layout can hold the content.

Type Template No 32.layout_intent: Dense fact/background plate for researcher biography, historical context, or origin background.
Type Template No 32.avoid_when: The content is a standard lecture list or a pure definition.

Type Template No 33.layout_intent: Dense evidence plate for supported findings, citations, statistics, or data with subpoints.
Type Template No 33.avoid_when: The source has no explicit evidence/data or a simpler fact plate is sufficient.

Type Template No 35.layout_intent: Split-screen glassbox contrast for exactly two concepts that each need multiple supported sentences.
Type Template No 35.avoid_when: A standard Differentiation or Template No 20 layout can hold the comparison.

Type Template No 36.layout_intent: Absolute-last-resort heavy-text plate for an irreducible academic/policy explanation.
Type Template No 36.avoid_when: The text can be summarized, listed, divided, or represented by any simpler template.

Type Template No 40.layout_intent: Case-study/person/object image paired with a compact supported description and source tags.
Type Template No 40.avoid_when: No specific supported image subject is present.

Type Template No 41.layout_intent: Flat pointer list for characteristics, benefits, features, or standalone ideas.
Type Template No 41.avoid_when: The content is hierarchical, sequential, comparative, or needs sub-pointers.

Process Template 1.layout_intent: Low-density ordered steps with short labels and brief explanations.
Process Template 1.avoid_when: Stages require detailed reasoning or multiple nested points.

Process Template 2.layout_intent: Moderately detailed procedure with a subheading and explanation per stage.
Process Template 2.avoid_when: The workflow is only labels or is deeply technical/multilevel.

Process Template 3.layout_intent: High-density technical or multilevel workflow with structured details.
Process Template 3.avoid_when: A simpler process layout can preserve all supported meaning.

Process Template 4.layout_intent: Modern split-screen process flow using step titles only, with icons or numbers.

Differentiation Template 1.layout_intent: Text-only side-by-side comparison of exactly two non-ordered sides.
Differentiation Template 1.avoid_when: The relationship is sequential/causal or images are necessary.

Differentiation Template 2.layout_intent: Image-supported comparison of exactly two brands, cases, or visual subjects.
Differentiation Template 2.avoid_when: Specific supported images are unavailable or the relationship is sequential.

Timeline Template 1.layout_intent: Low-density milestones using a time marker and very short event summary.
Timeline Template 1.avoid_when: Events require detailed supporting points or are not chronological.

Timeline Template 2.layout_intent: Detailed chronological analysis with time markers, titles, and supported bullets.
Timeline Template 2.avoid_when: The source provides only brief milestones.

Hierarchy Template 1.layout_intent: Node-based parent-child tree for taxonomy, organization, or architecture.
Hierarchy Template 1.avoid_when: The items are merely a flat list or ordered process.

Graph Template 1.layout_intent: Line graph for explicit numeric change over a continuous progression.
Graph Template 1.avoid_when: The transcript lacks numeric axes/values or compares discrete categories.

Graph Template 2.layout_intent: Bar plot for explicit numeric comparison across discrete categories.
Graph Template 2.avoid_when: The transcript lacks numeric values or describes continuous change.

Graph Template 3.layout_intent: Pie chart for explicit parts of a whole that total 100 percent.
Graph Template 3.avoid_when: Values do not represent a complete proportional distribution.

Importance Template.layout_intent: Module/topic introduction or summary emphasizing concise learner benefits and outcomes.
Importance Template.avoid_when: Detailed theory or full concept teaching is required.

IMT Mind Map.layout_intent: Course/module navigation map with a central topic and connected topic branches.
IMT Mind Map.avoid_when: Teaching detailed content rather than mapping the learning structure.

NMIMS Mind Map.layout_intent: NMIMS-specific module map combining topic structure, outcomes, and visible learner progress.
selection_cues: by the end of this module
NMIMS Mind Map.avoid_when: The content is not for NMIMS or is detailed concept teaching.

Soft Skills Template.layout_intent: Minimal headerless treatment for one short behavioral insight, takeaway, or key message.
Soft Skills Template.avoid_when: A detailed framework, multiple points, or long explanation is required.

Face Only.when_to_use: Speech is narrative (storytelling, personal anecdotes), transitional ("Now let's look at..."), or lacks any clear visual structure. This is the default fallback.

Template 1.when_to_use: Quick overview of 2–5 types where each type needs only a short label and a one-sentence key differentiator.

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 2 lines · max 32 characters
constraints.points: Max 3 points or sub-points per type
constraints.icons: Line icons required (replaceable with numbers or short-forms only)
constraints.overflow: > 4 types leads to splitting into two plates

Template 2.when_to_use: Detailed concept breakdowns where each type needs a subheading and a 2–3 individual bullet points each of length 6 to 8 words  .

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 2 lines · max 32 characters

Template No 16 Split Screen.when_to_use: Split-screen layout (speaker left, graphics right) where speech outlines a sequence of up to 4 distinct steps or concepts, each needing a short description of 6 to 10 words.

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 2 lines
constraints.description: Max 3 lines per point; bullet pointers allowed
constraints.overflow: > 4 types leads to splitting into two plates

Template No 16 OG.when_to_use: Full-page layout (no speaker visible) where speech outlines a sequence of up to 4 distinct steps or concepts, each needing a short description of 8 to 15 words.

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 2 lines
constraints.description: Max 3 lines per point; bullet pointers allowed
constraints.overflow: > 4 types leads to splitting into two plates

Template No 17 Split Screen.when_to_use: Split-screen layout where speech introduces numbered points that require an expanded detailed explanation or supporting graphics/images for a specific list item. limited to 20 words

constraints.heading: Omit if it would exceed two lines
constraints.images: Permitted (inside the sub-text box or briefly outside it)
constraints.overflow: > 5 types leads to splitting into two plates

Template No 17 OG.when_to_use: Full-page layout (no speaker visible) where speech introduces numbered points that require an expanded detailed explanation for every pointer or supporting graphics/images for a specific list item. limited to 20 words additionally support bullet points

constraints.heading: Omit if it would exceed two lines
constraints.images: Permitted (inside the sub-text box or briefly outside it)
constraints.overflow: > 5 types leads to splitting into two plates

Template No 18 Split Screen.when_to_use: Split-screen layout where speech follows a structured Q&A format, displaying specific questions alongside their answers.

constraints.answers: 2–3 answers per question (box extends to fit) each answer 6 to 10 words
constraints.usage: Only when both questions and answers must appear together
constraints.overflow: > 3 questions leads to splitting into two plates

Template No 18 OG.when_to_use: full page layout (No speaker visible) where speech follows a structured Q&A format, displaying specific questions alongside their answers.

constraints.answers: 2–3 answers per question (box extends to fit) each answer 6 to 15 words for each answer point
constraints.usage: Only when both questions and answers must appear together
constraints.overflow: > 3 questions leads to splitting into two plates

Template No 20 Split Screen.when_to_use: Split-screen layout where speech outlines exactly two distinct types, categories, or concepts, each needing a short description(8 to 10 words) or 2 to 3 bullet points each 5 to 7 words.

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 2 lines · 4 to 5 words max
constraints.content_alignment: Description only -> center-aligned; with pointers -> left-aligned
constraints.word_limit: Description text max 4 lines upto 12 words

Template No 20 OG.when_to_use: Full-screen layout (no speaker visible) showing exactly two concepts side-by-side. each needing a short description(8 to 10 words) or 2 to 3 bullet points each 5 to 7 words.

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 2 lines · 4 to 5 words max
constraints.content_alignment: Description only -> center-aligned; with pointers -> left-aligned
constraints.word_limit: Description text max 4 lines upto 15 words

Template No 21 Split Screen.when_to_use: Split-screen layout where speech outlines exactly three types or concepts, each requiring only a subheading and a supporting icon or supporting description (5 words maximum)

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 2 words
constraints.subheadings: Title Case · max 2–3 words inside the circle
constraints.icons: Required (can be replaced with short descriptions, but not recommended)
constraints.sub_bullets: Not supported (use Type Template No 21 OG instead)

Template No 21 OG.when_to_use: Full-page layout (no speaker visible) outlining three concepts represented by supporting icon or supporting description (5 words maximum), where concepts require brief text callouts or branching sub-pointers.

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 2 words
constraints.subheadings: Title Case · max 2–3 words inside the circle
constraints.icons: Required (can be replaced with short descriptions, but not recommended)
constraints.sub_bullets: Not supported (use Type Template No 21 OG instead)

Template No 22 Split Screen.when_to_use: Split-screen layout displaying 5–7 categories or types, where each category needs a title and a brief description of 5 words.

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 2 words
constraints.description: Sentence case · max 5 words per description
constraints.icons: Line icons required (cannot be omitted, can use numbers)
constraints.limit: Max 5 visible categories at once (if more, first two slide up)

Template No 22 OG.when_to_use: Full-screen layout (no speaker visible) displaying 5–7 categories or types, where each category needs a title and a brief description of 5–10 words.

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 2 words
constraints.description: Sentence case · max 10 words per description
constraints.icons: Line icons required (cannot be omitted, can use numbers)
constraints.limit: Max 5 visible categories at once (if more, first two slide up)

Template No 23 Split Screen.when_to_use: Split screen template where we are showing a process or a flow or a sequence of steps where each step is 5 words long

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 4 words
constraints.icons: Not nessesary, could be numbers or icons
constraints.limit: Max 5 visible categories at once (if more, first two slide up)

Template No 23 OG.when_to_use: Full screen layout (No speaker visible) where we are showing a process or a flow or a sequence of steps where each step is 8 words long

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 4 words
constraints.icons: Not nessesary, could be numbers or icons
constraints.limit: Max 5 visible categories at once (if more, first two slide up)

Template No 24 Glass BOX.when_to_use: Displaying a statistics fact, quantitative survey results, or percentage data in a glassbox card.

Template No 24 Split Screen.when_to_use: Split Screen template Displaying a statistics fact, quantitative survey results, or percentage data upto 15 words

constraints.heading: Optional · allowed only in Split-Screen · ALL CAPS

Template No 25 Glass Box.when_to_use: Displaying company, brand, product, or organization logos/images to build brand recall.

Template No 26 Question Box.when_to_use: Displaying a single focus question, reflection prompt, or discussion prompt for learner engagement.

Template No 26 OG.when_to_use: Displaying a single focus question, reflection prompt, or discussion prompt for learner engagement. only sentence

Template No 27.when_to_use: Defining a new term, theory, framework, or dictionary-style definition.

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS
constraints.definition_text: Sentence case · Continuous text or bullet pointers
constraints.processes: Do not use for sequential processes

Template No 28.when_to_use: Highlighting famous quotes, sayings, principles, or memorable statements.

Type Template No 29.when_to_use: Highlighting a key learning takeaway, conclusion, or brief definition. Does not use a header/title. must be a sentence

Type Template No 30.name: Box plate horizontal
Type Template No 30.when_to_use: Displaying up to 4 concepts, pillars, or framework elements horizontally side-by-side with subheading and description each subheading limited to 4 words discription could be running text or pointers, the word limit can be 10-15 if its running text  words per point if we are using pointers  max 3 points of length 6 words each ONLY when there is too much text to fit in simpler templates.

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 32 characters
constraints.subheading: Title Case (in each box) subheading is max 4 words
constraints.sub_pointers: Sentence case · max 6 words per pointer

Template No 31.name: box plate vertical
Template No 31.when_to_use: Displaying 2 or 3 vertically stacked boxes where more explanation space is needed per category, can be running text or pointers, for running text word limit is max 20 ONLY when simpler templates cannot fit the detailed text.

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 32 characters
constraints.sub_pointers: Sentence case maximum of 4 points each being 8 words max

Type Template No 32.name: fact/background plate
Type Template No 32.when_to_use: Structured teaching with 4–5 main points and subpointers, or providing historical context, researcher bio, or origin background, ONLY when the content is exceptionally detailed.

constraints.downweighted_status: Reserved strictly for researcher biographies, historical contexts, or origin backgrounds
constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 32 characters
constraints.subheadings: Mandatory · Title Case for each main point/fact
constraints.definitions: Do not use for pure definitions

Type Template No 33.when_to_use: Presenting evidence-based findings, research facts, statistics, or data points with subpointers ONLY when high text/data density is required.

constraints.downweighted_status: Reserved strictly for evidence-based scientific findings, citations, statistics, or data points
constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 32 characters
constraints.subheadings: Mandatory · Title Case for each point
constraints.sub_points: Can have multiple sub-points in sentence case

Type Template No 35.name: text glassbox
Type Template No 35.when_to_use: Split-screen layout displaying paired contrasting concepts or short statements in glassbox style ONLY when there is a significant volume of narrative text for each concept that requires multiple sentences.

constraints.downweighted_status: Do not select for simple comparisons; default to Differentiation Template 1/2 or Type Template No 20
constraints.heading: ALL CAPS 3 words max
constraints.description: short description 15 words, bulleted list, 3 points max each 4 words

Type Template No 36.name: heavy text plate
Type Template No 36.when_to_use: Detailed explanations, complex academic theories, or policy explanations that cannot be visualised using other templates. Used only as a last resort.

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 32 characters
constraints.subheading: multiple subheadings, 5 words each Title Case, text in bullets 3 to 4 under each , each can have subbullets

Type Template No 40.name: image with description
Type Template No 40.when_to_use: Presentation where a specific case study, historical person, scenario, object, or story is central to the narration.

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS
constraints.description: Sentence case · no trailing periods maximum 25 words/ can be pointers if pointers then 4 points of 6-7 words each, the
constraints.right_column: Dedicated case study image area (can use pointers and source tags)

Type Template No 41.name: pointers
Type Template No 41.when_to_use: Lists of characteristics, benefits, features, or standalone ideas without hierarchical complexity.

constraints.description: Sentence case · max 15 words per pointer
constraints.limit: Max 6 visible pointers before sliding up

Process Template 1.when_to_use: Simple ordered steps needing only short labels and brief explanations.

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 2 lines · max 20 characters
constraints.pointers: Bullets allowed · max 2 lines · aligned to the text
constraints.overflow: > 4 steps leads to first step sliding out

Process Template 2.when_to_use: Multi-stage reasoning or moderately detailed academic procedures; each stage needs a subheading and a descriptive explanation.

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 2 lines · max 32 characters
constraints.pointers: Can be faded to fit additional points
constraints.overflow: > 4 steps leads to first step sliding out

Process Template 3.when_to_use: Deep technical or multi-level workflows requiring headers, structured details, and multiple bullet points.

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 2 lines · max 32 characters
constraints.overflow: > 4 steps leads to first step sliding out

Process Template 4.when_to_use: Split-screen layout displaying a sequential process, workflow, or customer journey with step titles (1–5 words) and NO supporting description.

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS
constraints.limit: Max 5 stages visible at one time (first stage slides out if more)

Differentiation Template 1.when_to_use: Simple column-based text comparison of exactly two sides. Never use for chronological or ordered content.

constraints.overflow: > 4 differences leads to splitting into two plates (first 1-2 points slide out)
constraints.output_structure: Use alternating paragraph details labelled LHS1, RHS1, LHS2, RHS2, and so on; labels are regular weight and values are bold

Differentiation Template 2.when_to_use: Case studies or brand comparisons of exactly two sides requiring a dedicated visual/image area alongside explanation text.

constraints.content: Description and pointers below the image · max 2–3 lines
constraints.output_structure: Use alternating paragraph details labelled LHS1, RHS1, LHS2, RHS2, and so on; labels are regular weight and values are bold

Timeline Template 1.when_to_use: Brief milestones needing only a year/timestamp and a 3–5 word event summary.

constraints.images: Text can be replaced with images

Timeline Template 2.when_to_use: Detailed chronological analysis needing time markers, event titles, and supporting descriptive bullet points.

Hierarchy Template 1.when_to_use: Node-based tree structures representing hierarchies, taxonomies, organization structures, or architectures.

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS
constraints.node_text: Title Case · max 2 lines per node

Graph Template 1.when_to_use: Showing trends or performance over a continuous progression (X-axis vs Y-axis). Only use with explicit numeric data.

constraints.heading: Required · ALL CAPS
constraints.sub_points: May appear on the right side of the graph
constraints.source: Must be provided explicitly (e.g. 'Courtesy: Company Name')

Graph Template 2.when_to_use: Comparing quantities across discrete categories. Only use with explicit numeric data.

constraints.heading: Required · ALL CAPS
constraints.sub_points: May appear on the right side of the graph

Graph Template 3.when_to_use: Representing proportional distributions (parts of a whole summing to 100%). Only use with explicit numeric data.

constraints.heading: Required · ALL CAPS
constraints.sub_points: May appear on the right side of the graph

Importance Template.when_to_use: Introducing a module/concept with 5–6 subtopics, or summarizing 5–6 key outcomes/takeaways explained in a single sentence (max 12 words) focusing on practical benefits.

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 2 lines · as short as possible
constraints.description: Sentence case · max 2 lines · 10–12 words per point
constraints.theory: Do not explain the entire module or include detailed theory

IMT Mind Map.when_to_use: Visually showing the overall structure of a course or module and how topics connect (used as a navigation map). divided into 3 or 4 topics

constraints.heading: FULL CAPS · at the top
constraints.subheadings: topic names are the subheadings· max 2-3 words each topic is a list of maximum 5 constituents with 3-4 words each
constraints.usage: Do not use for detailed content explanations

NMIMS Mind Map.when_to_use: Visually mapping course/topic/module  divided into 3 or 4 constutuent subtopics.

constraints.subheadings: each constutuent topic is the subheading, each subheading should have an icon
constraints.interactive: Completed segments turn green to indicate progress
constraints.usage: Do not use for concept teaching or detailed content explanations

Soft Skills Template.when_to_use: Displaying short, simple 1-2 liner concepts, takeaways, summaries, Insights, or key messages (max 15 words). Does not use a header/title.

constraints.heading: Not permitted
constraints.description: Sentence case · max 2 sentences · max 15 words total
